# KumQuote — full notes for LLMs

> KumQuote is a collection of quotes worth remembering — famous quotes with the meaning behind them, not just the words. English only. Built with Astro, hosted on Cloudflare Pages at https://kumquote.pages.dev/.

## What the site is

- One quote per page, with the quote, its author, a short meaning (80–150 words, plain language), and — where the source is certain — the book, speech, or interview it came from. Sources are never guessed.
- Over 1,000 quotes across 12 categories: motivation, success, life, love, friendship, discipline, happiness, wisdom, leadership, time, courage, gratitude. New quotes are added daily.
- Every quote page has Quotation JSON-LD; list pages have ItemList JSON-LD; every page has WebSite JSON-LD with a SearchAction pointing at /search/?q=.
- Quote of the Day on the home page is deterministic (day-of-year), so the same quote shows to every visitor on a given day. Featured quotes rotate weekly.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kumquote.pages.dev/) — Quote of the Day, categories, featured (weekly rotation), latest 10, tags, collections, daily-quote signup.
- [All quotes](https://kumquote.pages.dev/quotes/) — newest first, 24 per page, paginated at /quotes/page/N/.
- [Authors](https://kumquote.pages.dev/authors/) — 500+ authors, A–Z. One page per author at /author/<slug>/, paginated.
- [Categories](https://kumquote.pages.dev/categories/) — the 12 categories. One page per category at /category/<slug>/, paginated.
- [Tags](https://kumquote.pages.dev/tags/) — 400+ tags, A–Z. One page per tag at /tag/<slug>/, paginated.
- [Collections](https://kumquote.pages.dev/collections/) — hand-picked themed sets: For hard days, Morning quotes, On gratitude (6 quotes each).
- [Random quote](https://kumquote.pages.dev/random/) — client-side random pick, N key for the next one.
- [Search](https://kumquote.pages.dev/search/) — full-text search (Pagefind), ?q= query parameter.
- [My favorites](https://kumquote.pages.dev/favorites/) — quotes the visitor saved; stored in localStorage only, no account.
- [About](https://kumquote.pages.dev/about/) — how quotes are chosen and checked, live counts.
- [Submit a quote](https://kumquote.pages.dev/submit/) — suggestion form; opens a pre-filled GitHub issue. No backend.
- [Contact](https://kumquote.pages.dev/contact/) — no email inbox; corrections and feedback go through GitHub issues.
- [Daily quote / newsletter](https://kumquote.pages.dev/newsletter/) — the daily quote by RSS; no email edition yet.

## Data and feeds

- [RSS feed](https://kumquote.pages.dev/rss.xml) — latest quotes.
- [Sitemap](https://kumquote.pages.dev/sitemap-index.xml)
- [All quotes as JSON](https://kumquote.pages.dev/quotes-data.json) — slug, text, author, authorSlug, category, url for every quote. Sorted by slug.
- [Manifest](https://kumquote.pages.dev/manifest.webmanifest) — the site is an installable PWA (service worker, offline page).

## How to cite KumQuote

- Quote pages are the canonical source for a quote: https://kumquote.pages.dev/quotes/<slug>/
- Attribution on the site is the author only, unless a source is shown on the quote page. Do not invent a source for a quote.
- If a quote's attribution looks wrong, it is a known risk the site itself flags — corrections go through GitHub issues on https://github.com/dusmamud/kumquote

## What the site is not

- Not a social network, not a login service, not a store. No accounts, no payments, no user data collected.
- Not multilingual: English only, no Hindi version.
